name: Spinazzola (Italy)
description: White field with a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Spinazzola (a red tower and a tree on a hill on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Spinazzola, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Spinazzola arms — red tower and a tree on a hill on white, crowned, within branches
